newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks close lower, Nomura impact limited.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks close lower, Nomura impact limited.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed lower on Friday, weighed down by profit-taking sales of issues that had risen earlier in the day. Players were discouraged by an absence of usual month-end buying to support the market.

News that Tokyo prosecutors had arrested Nomura Securities Co's former president in connection with a widening scandal involving suspected illegal payoffs to a racketeer had only a limited impact on the market, brokers said.
The 225-share Nikkei average lost 243.42 points or 1.20 percent to close at 20,068.81. June Nikkei futures fell 170 points to 20,140.
